summary.en: Ukrainian naval drones struck two Russian vessels at Benghazi and off Libya's coast, sinking one warship and damaging another, while killing two Libyan naval officers. Libyan forces and militias have threatened retaliation against Ukraine for the attack, and the Libyan army chief toured Morocco's F-16 base at Ben Guerir as part of new security ties. Italy has summoned the Ukrainian military envoy and is considering extra security for its troops in Libya. The Kremlin declined comment on reports of 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in the Ukraine war. 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Ukrainske marine-droner slo to russiske fartøyer ved Benghazi og utenfor Libyas kyst, senket ett krigsskip og skadet et annet, mens to libyske marineoffiserer ble drept. Libyske styrker og militsgrupper har truet med gjengjeldelse mot Ukraina for angrepet, og den libyske hærens sjef besøkte Marokkos F‑16‑base i Ben Guerir som del av nye sikkerhetsbånd. Italia har innkalt den ukrainske militære representanten og vurderer ekstra sikkerhet for sine tropper i Libya. Kreml avslo å kommentere rapporter om 700 000 russiske soldater drept i Ukraina-krigen. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Libyan crisis
background.extract: The Libyan crisis is the current humanitarian crisis and political-military instability occurring in Libya, beginning with the Arab Spring protests of 2011, which led to two civil wars, foreign military intervention, and the ousting and killing of Muammar Gaddafi. The first civil war's aftermath and proliferation of armed groups led to violence and instability across the country, which erupted into renewed civil war in 2014. The second war lasted until 23 October 2020, when all parties agreed to a permanent ceasefire and negotiations.
